column1: # France (fr.cautious): no majority. At Paris, one table for each member, from the research's Île-de-France
# Mawaqit survey (224 mosques), all three read at the Grande Mosquée's point (the other two mosques are 10
# and 13 km east of it, their own times up to 40 s earlier than there):
# - fr.twelve, the 12-13° family with Zuhr + 5 and Maghrib + 3..4: Drancy's 2026 table (12.7°, + 5.3, + 3);
# - fr.gmp: the Grande Mosquée's own 2026 table, January to September (its 2026 method; from October its
#   page carries its earlier method, and the Fajr start and Zuhr are not checked there, as in fr-gmp.tsv,
#   but its Fajr is, as the end of eating: E, ruling R80);
# - fr.fifteen, the flat 15° family: Al-Amel Neuilly-Plaisance's 2026 table (15°, + 0.6, + 1.1).
# A cautious entry has no margins of its own: every row is held out.
